entries: Professor Juniper: Hi there, {VAR 0100 0000}!{VAR BE01}

I heard about these Pokémon statues,
and I came to look into their origins!{VAR BE01}
It appears to be a statue of a Pokémon.

Give the RageCandyBar to the
Pokémon statue?
Cheren: Stop, {VAR 0100 0000}!{VAR BE01}
Alder went on ahead. Let's hurry.

Cheren: It's hard to put into words...
but I'll never forgive them for this!{VAR BE01}
The Xtransceiver is ringing.
{VAR 0100 0000} picked up the Xtransceiver.{VAR BE01}

I came clear out to the Desert Resort
to train, but...{VAR BE01}
There are so many Ground-type Pokémon,
and I'm already in tatters...

If a Pokémon holds this Soft Sand, the
power of its Ground-type moves goes up!

Oh! A sea of sand! I don't need
Go-Goggles here!{VAR BE01}
Oh, I've come here all the way from
the Hoenn region.
